en-US.longDescription: Bovo is a Gomoku (from Japanese 五目並べ - lit. "five points") like game for two players, where the opponents alternate in placing their respective pictogram on the game board. (Also known as: Connect Five, Five in a row, X and O, Naughts and Crosses)
en-US.name: bovo

zh-CN.longDescription: Bovo 是一款供两名玩家玩的类五子棋游戏，对手轮流在游戏板上放置各自的象形文字。
